messages.author: 2167f025066e0cf4
messages.subject: Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to run a Poisson regression with spatial and temporal random effects (i.e., y ~ x + f(model='ar1') + f(model='besag')). I have run this model in the past without any errors, but in my most recent attempts with a more filtered version of the same data set, I am now getting the following error:

GMRFLib version 3.0-0-snapshot, has recived error no [12]
Reason    : The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge
Message   : Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE
Function  : GMRFLib_init_GMRF_approximation_store__intern
File      : approx-inference.c
Line      : 2708
RCSId     : file: approx-inference.c  hgid: 85351f348950  date: Fri Jul 04 08:57:14 2014 +0100

Looking through old posts, this seems like it could be a scaling issue (albeit with other model types), but my response variable isn't that big (range: 0-200ish with most values <50) and my fixed effect only ranges from about 0-6. Are there any other potential causes for this error and how might I fix it? Thanks for your help.

Adam Green
